name: Airbnb via OpenBnB
author: John Jahn
description: Search Airbnb stays for your trip dates and add them to the trip. Each traveller signs in to their own free OpenBnB account - no scraping, no shared credentials.

settings.label: OAuth authorize URL
settings.hint: OpenBnB's authorize endpoint. Use the value printed by scripts/register-oauth-client.mjs.

settings.label: OAuth scopes (space-separated)
settings.hint: Leave blank. OpenBnB issues a full-access token for the signed-in account.

settings.label: OAuth client id
settings.hint: From the one-off registration script. Unique to this TREK instance.

settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.hint: From the same script. Stored encrypted; never leaves the host.

settings.label: OpenBnB MCP endpoint
settings.hint: Override only if you run a compatible MCP endpoint of your own. Defaults to the hosted OpenBnB server.
